s.d: A number of things that follow on one after the other or are connected one after the other
A regular stopping place for ground transportation
An official whose job is to receive taxes or other monies; a tax collector, a treasurer
A device for taking still or moving pictures or photographs
Food that is prepared and eaten, usually at a specific time, and usually in a comparatively large quantity
A tall, narrow structure (significantly taller than it is wide, either standing alone or forming part of a larger structure
One which receives or entertains a guest, socially, commercially, or officially
